Object Text: The BMS software requirements baseline shall be allocated to SWC_BatteryManagement on ECU_BMS_Main.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-000

Object Text: SWC_BatteryManagement shall be implemented as an AUTOSAR ApplicationSWC containing all battery state estimation, cell balancing, thermal management, and contactor control logic for the high-voltage traction battery pack.
Notes: Single SWC owns all BMS application logic; MCU runs at 12V, battery pack at 400V; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-001

Object Text: RE_EstimateSOC shall execute cyclically every 10 ms and compute the battery State-of-Charge using the specified SOC estimation method, writing the result to PP_SOCPercent.
Notes: 10 ms = 100 Hz; EKF runs two stages per cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-BMS-002

Object Text: RE_BalanceCells shall execute cyclically every 100 ms to compare individual cell voltages and activate passive bleed resistors on cells above the mean.
Notes: 100 ms cycle; passive balancing only — no active topology; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-BMS-003

Object Text: RE_ManageThermal shall execute cyclically every 50 ms to compute the battery temperature gradient, control the cooling pump PWM duty cycle, and apply power derating when thermal limits are approached.
Notes: 50 ms balances thermal inertia vs. response time; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-BMS-004

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall execute cyclically every 5 ms to perform overcurrent, overvoltage, undervoltage, and overtemperature plausibility checks and set the corresponding DTC within the same 5 ms execution when a fault is detected.
Notes: 5 ms = fastest cycle; safety actions must complete within one cycle; req_type=TIMING; hardened=0.1.0; verification=analysis; test=TD-REQ-BMS-005

Object Text: RE_ControlContactors shall execute on a DataReceivedEvent of VehicleReadyStatus to manage the precharge and main-contactor sequence (OPEN, PRECHARGE, MAIN_CLOSE) and verify the contactor state after each transition.
Notes: Event-driven; contactor sequence is safety-critical; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-006

Object Text: RE_Initialize shall execute once on ECU startup to read the last known SOC from NVM, perform a cell voltage scan, validate sensor signals, and set the SWC state to INIT only after RAM CRC and ROM CRC-32 self-tests complete.
Notes: NvM block ID: NvM_BMS_SOCLog; NvM_BMS_FaultLog; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-007

Object Text: SWC shall declare: RP_PackCurrent (SR IF_SR_Current, range ±500 A, res 0.1 A, 10 ms cycle via CAN ID 0x610), RP_CellVoltages (SR IF_SR_CellArray, 96 cells × float32, 100 ms), RP_CellTemperatures (SR IF_SR_TempArray, 32 NTC sensors × float32, 50 ms), RP_VehicleReadyStatus (SR IF_SR_VehicleReady, boolean, event-driven), RP_AmbientTemperature (SR IF_SR_Temperature, float32, 1 s).
Notes: All R-Ports follow AUTOSAR RP_ naming convention; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-010

Object Text: SWC shall declare: PP_SOCPercent (SR IF_SR_SOC, range 0.0–100.0 %, res 0.01 %, 10 ms), PP_SOHPercent (SR IF_SR_SOH, range 0.0–100.0 %, res 0.1 %, 1 s), PP_PackPowerLimit (SR IF_SR_PowerLimits, struct {f32ChargeLimitW, f32DischargeLimitW}, 50 ms), PP_BMSStatus (SR IF_SR_BMSStatus, struct {u8Mode, u8ActiveDTCs, u8BalancingActive}, 10 ms), PP_ContactorState (SR IF_SR_Contactor, enum {OPEN, PRECHARGE, CLOSED}, event-driven).
Notes: All P-Ports follow AUTOSAR PP_ naming convention; req_type=INTERFACE; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-011

Object Text: EKF_Predict() shall propagate the state vector [SOC, V_RC1, V_RC2] forward using the specified equivalent-circuit model and calibrated parameters.
Notes: ECM = 2nd-order RC equivalent circuit model; tau1=30s, tau2=300s typical; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-020

Object Text: EKF_Update() shall compute the Kalman gain and correct the state estimate using the measured pack voltage and the specified equivalent-circuit model.
Notes: OCV(SOC) is a 101-point lookup table stored as calibration ROM array; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-021

Object Text: SOC_Clamp() shall ensure the final SOC estimate is clamped to the range [SOC_MIN = 5.0 %, SOC_MAX = 95.0 %] before writing to PP_SOCPercent.
Notes: Clamping protects battery from full charge / full discharge damage; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-022

Object Text: When V_meas is unavailable (sensor timeout > 20 ms), RE_EstimateSOC shall fall back to pure coulomb counting: SOC(k+1) = SOC(k) - (I_pack * DT) / Q_nom and set bit[0] of PP_BMSStatus.u8Mode to indicate degraded estimation.
Notes: Degraded mode flag is read by instrument cluster for warning lamp; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-023

Object Text: CalcCellDelta() shall compute V_mean = sum(V_cell[i], i=0..95) / 96 and V_delta[i] = V_cell[i] - V_mean for each of the 96 cells. Cells with V_delta[i] > BALANCE_THRESHOLD_V (15 mV) are marked as candidates in l_u8BalanceMask bitmask (96 bits = 12 bytes).
Notes: BALANCE_THRESHOLD_V stored as calibration constant in ROM; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-030

Object Text: SelectBalanceCells() shall limit the number of simultaneously active bleed resistors to MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_BALANCE = 8 to prevent excessive heat generation.
Notes: 8-cell limit determined by thermal analysis of PCB heat dissipation; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-031

Object Text: SetBalanceRelays() shall write the selected l_u8BalanceMask to the cell monitoring IC via SPI within 1 ms of being called.
Notes: Cell monitoring IC: LTC6811-2 compatible protocol; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-032

Object Text: CalcTempGradient() shall compute T_max = max(T_cell[i], i=0..31), T_min = min(T_cell[i], i=0..31), and T_gradient = T_max - T_min.
Notes: High gradient indicates cooling blockage or cell degradation; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-040

Object Text: SetCoolingPWM() shall compute the PWM duty cycle for the cooling pump as: duty_cycle = K_COOL_P * (T_max - T_TARGET_K) + K_COOL_I * integral_error, where T_TARGET_K = 298.15 K (25 °C), K_COOL_P = 5.0 %/K, K_COOL_I = 0.1 %/(K·s).
Notes: PI controller; integral windup protection: clamp integral when output saturated; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-041

Object Text: RE_ManageThermal shall compute power derating factor: derate = 1.0 - clamp((T_max - T_DERATE_START_K) / T_DERATE_RANGE_K, 0.0, 1.0), where T_DERATE_START_K = 313.15 K (40 °C), T_DERATE_RANGE_K = 20 K. PP_PackPowerLimit.f32DischargeLimitW = P_MAX_W * derate. P_MAX_W = 150000 W (150 kW).
Notes: Linear derating from 100% at 40 °C to 0% at 60 °C; req_type=SAFETY; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-042

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall check I_pack against I_MAX_DISCHARGE = 300 A and I_MAX_CHARGE = -150 A every 5 ms.
Notes: 2-cycle debounce = 10 ms worst case; hardware fuse triggers at 500 A; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-050

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall check every cell voltage against V_CELL_MAX = 4.20 V and V_CELL_MIN = 2.50 V every 5 ms.
Notes: Per-cell check on all 96 cells; first violating cell ID stored in DTC snapshot; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-051

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall check T_max against T_CELL_MAX_K = 333.15 K (60 °C) every 5 ms.
Notes: Overtemp latch requires service reset to prevent repeated thermal damage; req_type=SAFETY; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-052

Object Text: OpenContactors() shall set PP_ContactorState = OPEN, zero the discharge and charge power limits, report the triggering DTC to DEM, and persist the fault record to NVM within the 5 ms RE_MonitorSafety window.
Notes: NvM write is non-blocking (deferred write mode) — does not block 5 ms cycle; req_type=SAFETY; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-053

Object Text: RE_ControlContactors shall implement the precharge sequence when VehicleReadyStatus transitions from OFF to ON: (1) Close precharge relay, set PP_ContactorState = PRECHARGE; (2) Monitor V_DC_link via RP_DCLinkVoltage; (3) When V_DC_link >= 0.95 * V_pack_nominal close main contactor; (4) Open precharge relay, set PP_ContactorState = CLOSED. Sequence timeout = 2 s; abort to OPEN if exceeded.
Notes: Precharge limits inrush current; 95% threshold from inverter capacitor spec; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-060

Object Text: VerifyContactorState() shall read back the physical contactor status from the contactor feedback pins via RP_ContactorFeedback and compare against the commanded state.
Notes: Contactor weld detection is an ASIL-D requirement; 50 ms = 10 contactor cycles; req_type=SAFETY; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-061

Object Text: RE_EstimateSOC shall update State-of-Health after each charge from 10 % SOC to 90 % SOC by computing Q_meas = integral(I_pack * DT) over that window and setting SOH = (Q_meas / Q_nom_new) * 100 %, where Q_nom_new = 100 Ah.
Notes: SOH degrades from 100% (new) to <80% (end-of-life threshold per ISO 6469); req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-070

Object Text: DTC_BMS_SOC_LIMIT (0xB10003) shall be reported via Dem_ReportErrorStatus when the raw SOC estimate exceeds SOC_MAX = 95 % or falls below SOC_MIN = 5 % for 10 consecutive 10 ms cycles.
Notes: DTC snapshot stored via Dem_GetEventFreezeFrameData; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-080

Object Text: All healable DTCs (0xB10001 through 0xB10007 excluding overtemp latch 0xB10002) shall be cleared automatically after 5 consecutive fault-free evaluation cycles.
Notes: Overtemp latch (0xB10002) requires manual reset; all others auto-heal; req_type=FUNCTIONAL; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-081

Object Text: All safety-relevant CAN input signals (RP_PackCurrent, RP_CellVoltages, RP_CellTemperatures) shall be protected by AUTOSAR E2E Profile 2.
Notes: E2E counter timeout = 30 ms worst case; req_type=SAFETY; split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-090

Object Text: RE_MonitorSafety shall trigger the hardware watchdog via Rte_Call every 5 ms.
Notes: Hardware watchdog is independent of software — ASIL-D decomposition; req_type=SAFETY; split into 3 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-091

Object Heading: Cell Voltage Sensor Loss Safe State
Object Text: When a cell-voltage measurement channel is invalid or lost for more than 100 ms, the BMS shall enter a safe state that inhibits charging and limits discharge power to zero.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-801

Object Text: When the commanded contactor state is OPEN but the feedback indicates CLOSED for more than 100 ms, the BMS shall set a contactor-weld DTC and inhibit precharge.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-802

Object Text: When the pack insulation resistance falls below the calibrated threshold, the BMS shall set an insulation fault, inhibit charging, and limit discharge power to the calibrated safe value.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-803

Object Text: When the cell temperature gradient exceeds the calibrated propagation threshold for more than 500 ms, the BMS shall set a thermal-propagation warning and request controlled shutdown.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-804

Object Text: The BMS shall validate the SOC and SOH estimates against the voltage-based and charge-integration references.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-805

Object Text: When a balance relay or bleed-resistor feedback indicates a stuck-on or open circuit for more than 200 ms, the BMS shall disable balancing and set a balancing fault DTC.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-806

Object Text: The BMS shall capture a freeze frame for each safety-relevant DTC containing pack current, pack voltage, cell voltage extrema, temperature extrema and SOC at the time of the fault, and persist it in NVM.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-807

Object Text: At startup and after a calibration update, the BMS shall verify that every safety-relevant calibration parameter is within its declared range and consistent with the battery variant.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-808

Object Text: The BMS shall only accept authenticated and integrity-protected software and calibration updates.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-809

Object Text: The BMS shall select cell count, capacity, chemistry, voltage limits and thermal limits from a validated battery-variant configuration.
Notes: hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-810

Object Text: The BMS shall expose test hooks to inject cell-sensor loss, contactor weld, insulation, thermal-gradient and plausibility faults.
Notes: split into 2 atomic parts; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-811

Object Text: DTC_BMS_SOC_LIMIT shall be set when the raw SOC estimate exceeds 95.0 % or falls below 5.0 % for more than 10 consecutive cycles.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-022, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1001

Object Text: Coulomb counting accumulation error shall not exceed ±2% SOC per hour.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-023, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1002

Object Text: If more than 8 cells exceed the threshold, the 8 cells with highest V_delta shall be selected.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-031, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1003

Object Text: Balancing shall be inhibited (all relays open) when pack current I_pack > 5 A (charging or discharging) to prevent measurement interference.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-032, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1004

Object Text: If T_gradient > TEMP_GRADIENT_LIMIT_K (8 K) for more than 5 consecutive 50 ms cycles, DTC_BMS_TEMP_GRADIENT (0xB10006) shall be set.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-040, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1005

Object Text: Duty cycle shall be clamped to [PWM_MIN = 0 %, PWM_MAX = 100 %].
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-041, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1006

Object Text: If I_pack > I_MAX_DISCHARGE or I_pack < I_MAX_CHARGE for more than 2 consecutive cycles (10 ms debounce), OpenContactors() shall be called and DTC_BMS_OVERCURRENT (0xB10001) set.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-050, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1007

Object Text: If any cell exceeds V_CELL_MAX or drops below V_CELL_MIN for 2 consecutive cycles, OpenContactors() shall be called and the corresponding DTC DTC_BMS_OVERVOLTAGE (0xB10004) or DTC_BMS_UNDERVOLTAGE (0xB10005) set.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-051, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1008

Object Text: If T_max exceeds T_CELL_MAX_K for 4 consecutive cycles (20 ms), OpenContactors() shall be called and DTC_BMS_OVERTEMP (0xB10002) set.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-052, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1009

Object Text: Recovery shall require manual service reset; automatic recovery is inhibited.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-052, part 3.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1010

Object Text: If commanded != actual for more than 50 ms, DTC_BMS_CONTACTOR_WELD (0xB10007) shall be set.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-061, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1011

Object Text: The system shall transition to FAIL_SAFE mode.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-061, part 3.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1012

Object Text: Healing counters shall be reset on each fault recurrence.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-081, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1013

Object Text: E2E counter mismatch on RP_PackCurrent shall trigger DTC_BMS_CAN_TIMEOUT (0xB10008) after 3 consecutive failures at 10 ms cycle.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-090, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1014

Object Text: A missed watchdog trigger shall cause the ASIL-D hardware watchdog to reset the ECU.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-091, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1015

Object Text: On restart, the SWC shall detect the watchdog reset cause via McuResetCause register and set DTC_BMS_WATCHDOG (0xB10009).
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-091, part 3.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1016

Object Text: The BMS software requirements baseline shall trace to the battery system/stakeholder requirements.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-000, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1017

Object Text: The BMS shall flag a plausibility fault when the deviation exceeds the calibrated tolerance.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-805, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=test; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1018

Object Heading: Software and Calibration Update Integrity — Part 2
Object Text: The BMS shall record a fault when verification fails.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-809, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1019

Object Text: The BMS shall publish the resulting mode and DTC bitmask.
Notes: Split from REQ-BMS-811, part 2.; hardened=0.1.0; verification=review; test=TD-REQ-BMS-1020
